name: A share loss doesn't offset a fund gain; it's carried forward against share gains
workings: The salary is taxed as in employee-75k: 13,935.657745, and the tariff's rate on the next euro is above the flat tax's, so the Günstigerprüfung doesn't apply
Shares: loss 10,000.00 − 7,000.00 = 3,000.00, which only offsets gains on shares (§20 Abs. 6 Satz 4 EStG)
Equity ETF: gain 10,000.00, 70% after the partial exemption = 7,000.00, in the general pot
Carried forward: 3,000.00 of share losses, without limit
Selling more shares in the same year with a 5,000.00 gain: the year's share loss offsets 3,000.00 of it, so 2,000.00 more is taxed: 26.375% × 2,000.00 = 527.50
